choices.A: Only their magnitudes need to be equal
choices.B: Their magnitudes are equal and their directions are the same
choices.C: Only their directions need to be the same
choices.D: Their initial points must be the same

question: What does it mean for two vectors to be equal?
solution: For nonzero vectors, equality means equal magnitudes and the same direction; two zero vectors are also equal. Equality does not depend on the initial points. Vectors can still be equal after translation. Therefore choose B.
